states.regulator_name: Maine Real Estate Commission, Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation
states.ARELLO_status: Optional certification path; Maine alternative guidelines available
states.reporting_requirements: Enrollment report and instructor evaluation summary within 30 days after each course completion; exact batching for continuous enrollment requires written confirmation.
states.record_retention_period: No numeric qualifying-education period located; retain indefinitely pending written Commission guidance.
states.refund_policy_rules: Provider policy required in distance-course administration materials; no statewide formula located.
states.enrollment_period: Provider deadline must be disclosed; no statewide maximum located.
states.final_exam_rules: Minimum 80 objective questions, topic-weighted, administered at course end; overall course grade at least 75%.
states.proctoring_rules: No Maine-specific mandatory technology or method located; proposed controls require Commission acceptance.
states.certificate_rules: Course title, student, numerical grade, beginning/completion dates, and authorized provider signature.
states.notes: 55-hour Sales Agent Course; 3 quizzes with at least 60 questions total; at least 2 case studies; no enrollment for credit before written approval.
